title: Robustness and Cybersecurity in the EU Artificial Intelligence Act
abstract: arXiv:2502.16184v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA) establishes different legal principles for different types of AI systems. While prior work has sought to clarify some of these principles, little attention has been paid to robustness and cybersecurity. This paper aims to fill this gap. We identify legal challenges and shortcomings in provisions related to robustness and cybersecurity for high-risk AI systems(Art. 15 AIA) and general-purpose AI models (Art. 55 AIA). We show that robustness and cybersecurity demand resilience against performance disruptions. Furthermore, we assess potential challenges in implementing these provisions in light of recent advancements in the machine learning (ML) literature. Our analysis informs efforts to develop harmonized standards, guidelines by the European Commission, as well as benchmarks and measurement methodologies under Art. 15(2) AIA. translated_title: 欧盟《人工智能法案》中的鲁棒性与网络安全
translated_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（AIA）为不同类型的人工智能系统确立了不同的法律原则。尽管先前的研究试图澄清其中一些原则，但对鲁棒性和网络安全却鲜有关注。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们识别了针对高风险人工智能系统（AIA第15条）和通用人工智能模型（AIA第55条）中与鲁棒性和网络安全相关条款存在的法律挑战和不足。我们表明，鲁棒性和网络安全要求系统对性能中断具备抵御韧性。此外，我们结合机器学习（ML）文献的最新进展，评估了实施这些条款时可能面临的挑战。我们的分析为制定统一标准、欧盟委员会发布的指南，以及AIA第15(2)条下的基准测试和测量方法等工作提供了参考。借此，我们试图弥合法律术语与机器学习研究之间的鸿沟。
tldr: 本文系统分析了欧盟《人工智能法案》中针对高风险AI系统（第15条）和通用AI模型（第55条）的鲁棒性与网络安全条款的法律挑战与不足，并结合机器学习最新进展评估其实施难点，致力于弥合法律术语与机器学习技术之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies legal challenges and shortcomings in the robustness and cybersecurity provisions of the EU AI Act (Art. 15 and Art. 55) for high-risk AI systems and general-purpose AI models, bridging the gap between legal terminology and machine learning research.
